lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's five? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 5? Nope!

lines.text: A ring of radius two rolls inside a hoop of radius ten.
lines.caption: A ring of radius 2 rolls inside a hoop of radius 10.

lines.text: How many full turns does it make in one lap?
lines.caption: How many full turns does it make in one lap?

lines.text: Here's the trick. Follow the center of the ring!
lines.caption: Here's the trick. Follow the center of the ring!

lines.text: It stays two from the hoop, so it travels a circle of radius eight.
lines.caption: It stays 2 from the hoop, so it travels a circle of radius 8.

lines.text: With every full turn, the center moves one rim length, four pi.
lines.caption: With every full turn, the center moves one rim length, 4π.

lines.text: That circle is sixteen pi long. So divide by four pi!
lines.caption: That circle is 16π long. So divide by 4π!

lines.text: Sixteen pi over four pi. That's four full turns!
lines.caption: 16π over 4π. That's 4 full turns!

lines.text: Five was the trap. The dot touches the hoop five times.
lines.caption: 5 was the trap. The dot touches the hoop 5 times.

lines.text: Did you get four? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 4? Tell me below!
